newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision declines comment on WSJ report.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision declines comment on WSJ report.

text.p: Cablevision Systems Corp declined Thursday to comment on a Wall Street Journal report about its supposed plans to sell nearly $1.0 billion in cable systems to pay off debt.
A company spokesman said the report published in the financial daily's early Thursday electronic edition was based on a conference call that Cablevision made to analysts. He declined to elaborate.

The report said the company planned to sell systems that served 475,000 cable customers in non-core markets. It said James Dolan, Cablevision's chief executive officer, did not say whether any sale was imminent.
Proceeds from a possible sale would be used to reduce the company's $4 billion in debt, it added.
